title: 从破产到月入70万，4年就够了

{"ops": [{"insert": "从破产到月入70万，4年就够了"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 1}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "演员梦碎后，他用Magai证明自己", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Dustin Stout本应该成为actor。Small-town Pennsylvania kid moves to Hollywood，chases the dream，learns the craft。但Hollywood对他有别的计划。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Auditions dried up，found himself as youth director at non-profit，then designing t-shirts at Christian print shop。Not exactly red carpet。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但那个print shop是他taught himself web design的地方。And discovered something felt like superpower：social media。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Extrovert with lifelong obsession with technology，clicked immediately。Learned from Michael Hyatt about building platform through blogging和social media。Started writing about what learning，before long people paying for advice。2014年，went full-time as marketing consultant。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但client work has ceiling，especially for perfectionist。Realized could pour that perfectionism into digital products、help tens of thousands people instead of one client at a time。So built first product in 2014 with couple partners。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Then came 2020。Left company after years of stagnation、differing visions。Followed was brutal：two failed products、depleted savings、probably lowest point of professional life。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Rock bottom is powerful motivator。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "And then ChatGPT dropped。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "二、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Saw it immediately——where all going over next decade。Started using ChatGPT obsessively、kept running into same frustrations。Why doesn't it do this？Why can't access that model？Why interface so clunky？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "So built solution himself。That's "}, {"insert": "Magai", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "：all-in-one AI platform give access to world's best AI models——text、image、video、soon audio——all in one place，for one price。No juggling subscriptions。No managing API keys。Just best of AI，simplified。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Right on cusp of hitting $100k MRR（约70万人民币）。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "三、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Built Magai before vibe coding possible。Initial product built entirely with no-code tools、some digital duct tape、sheer determination。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Not developer，but refused let that stop。Pieced together first prototype using Bubble、webhooks、Zapier、every automation tool could get hands on。Scrappy——held together by willpower more than elegant code。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Name came from simple idea：AI revolution felt almost magical。Wanted capture that。Magic + AI = Magai。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Built solve own problems first，so every feature in first version existed because personally needed it。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "No funding。No team。Just him，working nights和weekends，figuring out as went。First version somewhat pretty、worked well enough。Sometimes that's all need prove idea has legs。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "四、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Biggest challenge was building on foundation couldn't scale。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "As grew，hit Bubble's ceiling，but kept pushing。Team——some of best engineers ever worked with——got creative。Custom Python和Node.js proxy servers。Workarounds pushed no-code further than designed go。Worked until——didn't。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Eventually，no choice but rebuild entire application from scratch on custom codebase。Transition consumed enormous time和resources。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Version 3 complete rebuild：Node.js、Supabase、modern stack optimized for Vercel。Stripe handle payments。ConvertKit manage email marketing。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Internally，ClickUp keeps organized，Slack keeps connected。Core。Everything else negotiable，but those non-negotiable。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "If had to start over，make same choice launch with no-code——let validate idea fast with zero technical resources。But plan for migration sooner。Build with assumption success would require complete rebuild、start laying groundwork earlier。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "五、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Another big challenge more personal：building while broke。Every decision carried weight because failure meant losing home。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "That pressure both crushing and clarifying。No room for distraction或vanity metrics。Every feature had matter。Every dollar had count。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Looking back，wouldn't trade that pressure。Forced discipline still shapes operate today。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "六、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Grew Magai through word of mouth，built on foundation of trust。That's it。No paid ads。No growth hacks。No shortcuts。Just decade of showing up。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Before Magai existed，spent years building audience through blogging和social media。Learned early from Michael Hyatt that could build platform by consistently providing value、being transparent about journey。So that's what did。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "By time launched Magai，had email list of nearly 100,000 subscribers、genuine relationships with domain experts和influencers in digital space。When shared what building，didn't just pay attention——helped spread word。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Shared everything as built：good、bad、messy middle。No polished marketing。Just raw、honest progress。Transparency built trust。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Building in public meant early users weren't just customers。Invested in journey。Became evangelists because felt like part of story。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Product also solved real、felt need。People drowning in AI subscriptions和scattered tools。Magai simplified everything into one platform。When solve genuine problem，users do marketing for you。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "What most people miss："}, {"insert": "relationships compound。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": " Connections invest in today become unfair advantage tomorrow。Can't manufacture that overnight。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Transparency is language of trust。Speak it consistently，people show up when matters。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "七、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Business model radically simple："}, {"insert": "one subscription，everything included。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Pay monthly fee、get access to all AI models、all tools、all features。No tiered feature gates。No confusing pricing matrices。Only difference between plans is usage volume。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Pay AI providers based on what users consume。Handle complexity——API management、billing relationships、infrastructure——so users don't have to。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Also focused on retention over acquisition。Simple、valuable product people actually use creates long-term customers。Rather have loyal users stick around for years than flood of signups who churn in month。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Sustainable growth beats vanity metrics every time。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "八、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "三条建议："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "1. Lead with value。Always。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "If building company just make money，might succeed——but probably won't survive hard parts。When revenue dries up、product fails、everything falls apart，money isn't enough motivation keep going。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "But if solving real problem for real people——people who aren't just "customers"或"users" but actual humans whose lives want improve——that purpose becomes fuel。Carries through seasons require pure grit。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Need clear reason why doing this。Not mission statement for website。Real、visceral reason gets out of bed when everything broken。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2. Build in public。Relentlessly。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Transparency is language of trust。In world full of faceless companies和polished marketing，being genuinely open about journey——wins AND failures——is competitive advantage。People don't just buy products。Buy into people they trust。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "3. Start before ready。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Launch before it's perfect。First version will be embarrassing——ship it anyway。Learn more from real users in week than from planning in isolation for year。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Decide to be unstoppable force。Then prove it by showing work。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "九、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Magai will be billion-dollar company serving one million customers within next three years。但revenue只是real mission的byproduct：democratizing AI access for everyone。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Not building for Silicon Valley。Not building for developers和data scientists。Building for everyday people doing everyday work——everyday office worker、electrician、plumber、coach、consultant、marketer、admin assistant、side-hustling mom、founder balancing all plates at once。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "AI shouldn't require technical background use effectively。Shouldn't require juggling ten subscriptions、managing API keys。Most powerful technology in generation should be accessible to anyone willing use it。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "That's what building。One platform。All best AI。For everyone。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Future belongs to people who embrace these tools——going to make sure that future isn't gatekept by complexity或cost。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "写在最后"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Dustin的故事是redemption story——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Actor failed。Youth director。T-shirt designer。Consultant。Failed founder x2。Now $100k MRR。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "His secret weapon？"}, {"insert": "A decade of building relationships and audience。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Not that he had 100k email list overnight。He spent years providing value before asking for anything。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Then when Magai launched，people listened。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Key insights——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Rock bottom can be powerful motivator", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "No-code to validate，then rebuild for scale", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Word of mouth > Paid ads（if you have trust）", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Simple pricing > Complex tiers", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Retention > Acquisition", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Most importantly："}, {"insert": "Lead with value。Always。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": " Whether you have 10 users或10,000。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "原文来自Indie Hackers，由AI翻译并改写", "attributes": {"italic": true}}]}
content_en: From bankruptcy to seven hundred thousand monthly just four years. After actor dream shattered he proved himself with Magai. Dustin Stout was supposed to be actor. Small-town Pennsylvania kid moves to Hollywood chases the dream learns the craft. But Hollywood had other plans for him. Auditions dried up found himself as youth director at non-profit then designing t-shirts at Christian print shop. Not exactly red carpet. But that print shop is where he taught himself web design. And discovered something felt like superpower social media. Extrovert with lifelong obsession with technology clicked immediately. Learned from Michael Hyatt.
